{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with sentinel value -999.0
sentinel_mask = data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0

# Filter out rows with sentinel values
valid_data = data[~sentinel_mask]

# Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline for valid data
mean_baseline = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (excluding sentinel values): {mean_baseline:.4f} ng/mL")"}
